blogs.title: From LSTM Roots to xLSTM: What Happens When You Scale a Classic RNN?
blogs.description: A beginner‑friendly tour of how xLSTM takes the proven LSTM architecture and pushes it into the scale‑chasing era of modern LLMs. The post explains the motivation behind scaling LSTMs, the challenges of vanishing gradients and memory limits, and how xLSTM’s new exponential gating and matrix memory help LSTMs keep up with Transformers.

blogs.title: Exponential Gating Explained: A Simple Twist That Lets LSTMs Rewrite Their Past
blogs.description: Dive into the core innovation of xLSTM—exponential gating. We unpack what it means to replace sigmoid gates with exponential ones, why it solves the problem of revising memory, and how the added stabilizer log‑state keeps training numerically safe. Readers learn through diagrams and analogies how this tweak turns an ordinary LSTM into a state‑tracking powerhouse.

blogs.title: Matrix Memory in Action: Why xLSTM’s mLSTM Beats Traditional Key‑Value Stores
blogs.description: Explore the new matrix‑based memory of xLSTM’s mLSTM block. This article walks through the covariance update rule, shows how key/value pairs are stored in a d×d matrix, and compares its storage capacity to Transformer attention heads. It also covers practical implications: linear context time, constant memory usage, and why these properties matter for edge deployments.

blogs.title: Residual Blocks Reimagined: How xLSTM Combines RNNs with Modern Feed‑Forward Tricks
blogs.description: Not all RNNs are created equal—discover how xLSTM integrates its sLSTM and mLSTM cells into Transformer‑style residual backbones with up‑projection stages. The post explains pre‑ vs post‑up‑projection designs, connects them to Cover’s theorem, and shows why this architectural blend yields better long‑range understanding without going quadratic.

blogs.title: Benchmarks That Matter: xLSTM vs Transformers, SSMs, and Other Expressive Models
blogs.description: A data‑driven review of the experiments in the paper. Readers see side‑by‑side comparisons across language modeling perplexity, Long Range Arena scores, associative recall accuracy, and downstream reasoning tasks. Practical takeaways include which xLSTM block ratios (sLSTM vs mLSTM) work best for different scales and why.

blogs.title: Scalability Secrets of xLSTM: What You Can Expect When You Double Your Data or Parameters
blogs.description: Scaling laws are the new performance metric for LLMs. This blog decodes how xLSTM follows a similar power‑law trend as Transformers but starts from a lower hinge point—potentially outperforming at larger sizes. We translate those math curves into real‑world implications for model builders deciding between a transformer or an xLSTM foundation.
